_comment: IPIP-50 item bank. Populate from ipip.ori.org (IPIP items are public domain). 50 rows: 10 per domain, each keyed + or -. Domain names must match DOMAINS in schema.js exactly. VERIFY THE KEYING — a flipped reverse-key silently inverts an entire domain.
_selfTest: Answer every item 5. If the resulting domain scores are all 50, your keying is wrong — reverse-keyed items should pull scores apart.
